# Reader compatibility removal during bounded migrations
A reader cleanup that drops a legacy-shape fallback must be reviewed against persisted mixed snapshots and migration scheduling, even when all new writers emit the current shape. A bounded background migration without a completion gate leaves supported legacy rows reachable; a single strict reader access can fail a whole listing. Current-write and empty-list tests can both pass while this regresses existing data. Verify listing before migration and after a partial batch, preserving every original value; retire compatibility only once completion and the read contract justify it. Observed in destination reader cleanup: reader.py:2 caused KeyError('destination') through api.list_destinations on data/records.json before migration and after migrate_batch(records, 1).
